snippet.title: Black Friday Janitor: Clean the Whole Mall - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Black Friday Janitor: Clean the Whole Mall hands you the biggest clean-up job of the year! Over 18,000 items, with dozens of unique stores across a huge, once-beautiful mall! Organize products, pick up trash, clean stains, to return the mall to its former glory! Improve your cleaning skills to learn new tricks. And remember, it's a big job, so don't expect to finish it all in one go!
